evals.prompt: Write a Playwright E2E browser test verifying the user login flow on localhost.
evals.expected_output: The skill auto-detects Playwright, uses getByRole locators, enforces localhost safety, and avoids sleep timers.
expectations: Auto-detects Playwright E2E framework from project files
Uses resilient role locators and auto-waiting assertions without arbitrary sleeps
Restricts execution strictly to localhost/staging environments

evals.prompt: Author a Cypress test for checkout flow with visual regression snapshots and mobile viewport emulation.
